title: Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this wastewater application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by mist eliminator demister grid frame and fat life requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for wastewater geometry
TIG welding all-position for net-shape tolerance
Passivation DI rinse for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces
commonFailures: Biofouling accumulation on stagnant surfaces - reduced by smooth surface finish Ra <0.8um and regular CIP

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame suitable for Mist eliminator demister grid frame?
faq.a: Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address wastewater operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. wastewater components receive Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the service environment.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Mist Eliminator Frame shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements; (4) Surface roughness certification on critical features. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Demister frame / Mist pad holder wastewater components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
